concepts.description: Software-as-a-Service: applications delivered as hosted services.

concepts.description: Popular tooling for building and running container images.

concepts.title: Deployments
concepts.description: Declarative rollout of application replicas and updates.

concepts.description: Service level indicators and objectives that quantify reliability targets.

concepts.title: Incident Response
concepts.description: Process for detecting, mitigating, and learning from production incidents.

concepts.description: Forecasting and provisioning resources to meet demand under SLOs.

concepts.title: SRE
concepts.description: Engineering discipline applying software practices to operations and reliability.

concepts.description: Verifying identity of a principal before granting access.

concepts.description: Deciding which actions an authenticated principal may perform.
